title: feat(spec): the published JSON Schema states the marketplace taxonomy facets' no-duplicates rule as uniqueItems
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoUxLbaBgDztWPQ9vNHLD3v5)_

Fixes #31036

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches the facets' duplicate rule, and the reference renderer prints no `uniqueItems`, so nothing in `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` states the narrowed rule.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：spec 导出的 JSON Schema 现在把市场分类的「同一维度不能重复」写成 `uniqueItems: true`。`businessFunctions`、`industries` 两个维度本身，以及嵌着它们的 6 个 schema（Package、CreatePackageRequest、UpdatePackageRequest、MarketplaceListing、TemplateManifest、MarketplaceSearchResponse）都带上了这条规则。
- 为什么改：这条规则在 TypeScript/Zod 校验里一直生效（`['sales', 'sales']` 会被拒），但导出 JSON Schema 时丢了，编辑器提示和外部校验工具会放行重复值，作者要到发布时才被平台拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：运行时接受与拒绝的内容完全不变，只是发布的 schema 补上了运行时早已执行的规则；JSON Schema 新拒的文档运行时本来就拒。对只读发布 schema 的工具来说这是一次收窄（changeset 标了 BREAKING 与 ADR-0087 不需迁移），版本仍是 patch。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/shared/refinement-projection.ts`（新的 `unique-items` 规则与「只对标量成立」的论证）；`packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts`（`distinct()` 改用已声明的谓词，表达式不变）；`packages/spec/scripts/refinement-projection.test.ts`（等价性与 Zod 行为不变的钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && node -e "console.log(require('./packages/spec/json-schema/marketplace/MarketplaceBusinessFunctions.json').uniqueItems)"`，预期打印 `true`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **A sixth arm in the closed refinement projection: `unique-items`.** `src/shared/refinement-projection.ts` adds the arm to `ProjectableRefinement` and `PROJECTABLE_REFINEMENT_PATTERNS`, plus a declared predicate `UNIQUE_SCALAR_ITEMS` (`new Set(values).size === values.length`) and the `JsonScalar` type it takes. The generator half (`scripts/lib/refinement-projection.ts`) emits it as JSON Schema's own `uniqueItems: true`, beside the node's `type` / `items` / `minItems` / `maxItems` (no `allOf`: `uniqueItems` is not a keyword the reference renderer reads as a type).
- **Exact only on JSON scalars, and the type says so.** A `Set` compares with SameValueZero, `uniqueItems` with JSON equality. On strings, numbers, booleans and `null` those are one relation (`0` and `-0` are one value to both; `"1"` and `1` are two to both; `NaN` is not JSON). On objects they are not: a `Set` compares by identity, so two equal objects would be two members to the runtime and one value to the file. The predicate's parameter is `readonly JsonScalar[]`, so composing it on a list of objects is a compile error rather than a wider-than-runtime file.
- **The taxonomy helper uses the declared predicate.** `distinct()` in `src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts` passes `UNIQUE_SCALAR_ITEMS` instead of an inline copy of the same expression, and its item type is bounded to `z.ZodType<JsonScalar>` so the call type-checks. Same message, same `min` / `max`, same accept set. (Declared deviation below.)
- **Ledger.** `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json` deletes 8 entries (14 sites), and its `measured` block is re-read from this build: 252 published schemas / 1023 dropped sites / 728 projected / 0 undecidable (was 260 / 1037 / 369 / 0; see Acceptance notes on the 369).
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` patch with both declaration lines (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`), the `**BREAKING (published artifact narrows)**` banner and one `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker, as the earlier arms of this list carried.
- **The arm's limit, stated where a composer reads it.** The `unique-items` docblock and `UNIQUE_SCALAR_ITEMS` carry a ⛔ paragraph: the item parse must be the identity on scalars (`z.enum`, `z.literal`, `z.string()`, `z.number()`, `z.boolean()`, `z.null()`), never a coercing, trimming, case-folding or transforming item, because the predicate judges the parsed output and the keyword the document, so such an item would publish a file wider than the runtime while the ledger reads `projected`.

### Schemas that gain `uniqueItems`

The `distinct()` helper is file-local to `taxonomy.zod.ts` and has exactly two callers. Every published schema that reaches them gains the keyword, and nothing else does (generator census: `14 unique-items`):

| ledger entry (deleted) | sites now `projected` |
|:---|:---|
| `marketplace/MarketplaceBusinessFunctions` | root |
| `marketplace/MarketplaceIndustries` | root |
| `marketplace/Package` | `businessFunctions`, `industries` |
| `marketplace/CreatePackageRequest` | `businessFunctions`, `industries` |
| `marketplace/UpdatePackageRequest` | `businessFunctions`, `industries` |
| `marketplace/MarketplaceListing` | `businessFunctions`, `industries` |
| `marketplace/TemplateManifest` | `businessFunctions`, `industries` |
| `marketplace/MarketplaceSearchResponse` | `items.element.businessFunctions`, `items.element.industries` |

All are intended: each is the facet itself or a schema whose property is the facet.

## Tests

`scripts/refinement-projection.test.ts` (the arm's shared harness, two new top-level `describe` blocks):

- the closed roster pin gains `unique-items`;
- the predicate declares itself; the emit is `uniqueItems: true` beside the node's own keywords; it is idempotent;
- **equality pin**: over a scalar corpus (duplicates, case, `"1"` vs `1`, `0` vs `-0`, `1` vs `1.0` after `JSON.parse`, `true` vs `1`, `null`), a JSON-equality `uniqueItems` evaluator that is deliberately not a `Set` agrees with the predicate on every list;
- a `@ts-expect-error` pin that an array of objects cannot compose the predicate (live: the scripts tsconfig compiles the file);
- **live seam**: both facet schemas publish `uniqueItems: true` and keep their array shape; `Package` states it at both properties; runtime and keyword agree on a facet corpus; the census reads every one of the 14 sites `projected` naming `unique-items` with nothing dropped, for all 8 schemas;
- **Zod unchanged** (seat's ask): the same accept/refuse verdicts as before on a corpus, including the duplicate refusal with its `custom` code and the helper's own message.

Ablation (committed first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk 1 → 0 anchor hits): with the emit body replaced by `void jsonSchema;`, 7 of the new cases go red (`Tests 7 failed | 81 passed`), including the census case, which shows the detector measures the generator's projection; restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Declared deviation

The claim's file surface lists the Zod schemas as out of bounds ("stop on breach"). The arm cannot see an inline arrow: the projection recognises only predicates registered through a factory in `refinement-projection.ts` (a `WeakMap` keyed on the function, and the design refuses `fn.toString()` matching). So `distinct()` in `taxonomy.zod.ts` changes three lines: the import, the inline predicate swapped for `UNIQUE_SCALAR_ITEMS` (same expression), and a type-only bound `T extends z.ZodType<JsonScalar>`, because Set equality matches JSON `uniqueItems` only on scalars and the bound keeps that guarantee at compile time instead of behind a cast. The seat ruled this in (seat thread, 2026-11-06 20:12Z ruling A for the swap, 20:14Z for the bound). No schema shape, message or accept set moves; the Zod-unchanged test above pins it.

## Acceptance notes

- **`measured.refinementSitesThatDidProject` was stale on `main`.** It read 369, while by arithmetic the generator on `main` reads 714 (the 728 measured here minus the 14 sites this PR projects; not re-run on `main`). The other three `measured` values matched by arithmetic. The block is hand-kept and no gate reads it; I re-read all four from this build rather than moving only the three this change touches.
- **Other `Set`-uniqueness refinements left alone.** `src/security/tenant-layer0-verdict.ts` (`organizationIds`, a scalar list) is the same shape and could compose `UNIQUE_SCALAR_ITEMS`; `src/data/object.zod.ts` (`groups` unique by `key`) is uniqueness of a projection, not of items, so it is not this arm. Neither is in this card's surface.
- **Clause-② reading (re-ruled by contract review 6695604767).** The published accept set narrows at 14 sites, so the declaration is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: nothing widens, and a narrowing of a published artifact is breaking. The level stays `patch` because, under ruling A, it follows `Metadata-protocol: none` alone; the sibling arm's `minor` (170fd83) predates that ruling.
- **Not done from the review's ④:** the optional extra line inside `distinct()` restating the identity-parse rule. The seat's ruling capped `taxonomy.zod.ts` at three lines, so the rule lives in `refinement-projection.ts`, which `distinct()` imports from.
- **Neighbours.** No open PR touches `refinement-projection.ts` (either half), `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` or `taxonomy.zod.ts` (read against the heads of the open code PRs around 20:30Z).
- **Reference pages** under `content/docs/references/**` do not move: the reference renderer does not print `uniqueItems`.
